integrity: Proof based on exact stationary generator identities, a first-reset covariance decomposition and bounded small-time excursion estimates. The included algebraic checker is supplementary. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive propulsion and orientation-flip rate; large-reset limit only.
Odd dissipative smooth drag with a compact accessible velocity interval.
No uniform estimate as orientation-flip rate tends to zero; no non-Poisson clocks.
title: The fifth-order drag fingerprint of rapid velocity resetting in a persistent active particle
